name: Optimist
bio: Always looks on the bright side. Expects the best from people and products.
whyPerfect: Brighten your day with these stylish and comfortable flats. Perfect for any occasion and guaranteed to make you feel good.
description: Lightweight mesh upper. Flexible sole for all-day comfort.
imagePrompt: Portrait of a smiling, cheerful woman in her 20s, bright colors, sunny day.

details.bio: Joy is enthusiastic and loves trying new things. She is drawn to positive messaging and bright aesthetics.

name: Pessimist
bio: Highly skeptical of marketing claims. Expects products to fail and looks for flaws.
whyPerfect: Durable and reliable. These flats are built to last and handle unexpected conditions, giving you peace of mind.
description: Heavy duty mesh upper with reinforced stitching. Extra grip rubber sole.
imagePrompt: Portrait of a serious man in his 50s, skeptical expression, natural lighting.

details.bio: Arthur values durability and transparency above all. He is hard to please and quick to spot failures.
